items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I know that's why I'm Mr. McComber. I don't even see nothing about little joys. So I told him about it.

ctx.x: And when Charlotte's seen it, they'd sure she'd just take it. You see? She'd just take it. Yeah. Yeah. And give them anything. We should go hide it from myself. They'd say something when I go to my bar at Clinton and bring out their shirt to you.

Yeah. Yeah. I've been reading the different books. I said, I don't, I don't see nothing about, you know, I know that's why I'm Mr. McComber. I don't even see nothing about little joys. So I told him about it. You know, I said, that's the stuff. The real stuff. Yeah, that's the stuff. That's the stuff.
That's the first picture I've seen of them. Well, that other picture in the circus band was.
